1. CHOOSE AN ADHESIVE SET
Use a proper adhesive set depending upon the ambient
temperature.

2. CHECK ADHESIVE USABLE TIME
After mixing the main and hardening agents, finish glass
installation within the specified time as shown.
Example:
For glass installation in ambient temperature of 25°C
(77°F), apply adhesive set No. 35 within 45 minutes.

3. CHECK ADHESIVE HARDENING TIME
When the main and hardening agents are mixed, leak tests
should be made only after the hardening time has elapsed.
Example:
Hardening time for adhesive set No. 35 with ambient
temperature of 25°C (77°F) is 150 minutes.
CAUTION: Do not drive the vehicle until at least double
the hardening time has elapsed.
